Former Ukrainian military officer Serhii Kuznietsov has gone on trial in Hamburg, Germany, accused of orchestrating the September 2022 bombing of the Nord Stream gas pipelines.

German prosecutors allege he led a team of Ukrainian military personnel who used a rented yacht, forged documents, and military-grade explosives to destroy critical energy infrastructure connecting Russia and Germany.

Prosecutors say the operation was planned on behalf of Ukrainian state authorities.

Kuznietsov faces charges including complicity in war crimes for attacking civilian infrastructure. He denies involvement, while Kiev continues to deny responsibility.
